global: A rich, amber shoyu ramen broth cradles tender chashu pork and dark nori sheets, artfully arranged atop noodles. The bowl, adorned with dragon motifs, rests on a warm wooden table, bathed in soft, inviting light.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and subtle texture beneath the bowl.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with green dragons and red geometric patterns along its rim.
regions.soup: Shoyu ramen broth with noodles, garnished with seaweed, green onion, and pork, appears rich, amber-colored, and glossy.
regions.seaweed: Dark green nori seaweed pieces, irregularly shaped with textured, slightly glossy surfaces, appear partially submerged in broth.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows golden-brown seared edges, tender pale interior, and irregular curved shape with slight fat marbling.
